summary: Removed Conversation initiative and all automatic and manual check-ins.
instructions: Open Chat: Conversation initiative is no longer in Settings, and Veyra will not start scheduled conversations or make check-in model requests, even if you previously enabled the feature. Existing chat history, service selection, and credentials are unchanged. Older open pages update through the shared update monitor after restart; unsent drafts and private forms are preserved until you finish editing. Tested with 158 Python tests, the self-test, JavaScript syntax checks, desktop/mobile chat runtime checks, and full-width scrolling/layout checks at four screen widths.
